svg.title: The Great Fish Rescue — project card
svg.desc: A storybook set in the desert: find four hidden ponds, then steer each fish into the stream of its colour and count them, in two games bound into the book. Built with Css 3D, Javascript, Web Audio. Live demo. Banner: the book's real cover.
